properties.decision_summary: Minted three design decisions without building: DD-12 (mutation & conflict model for records/**: status quo vs event-sourced per FOUNDATION-PLAN D2 vs revision stamp + resolver), DD-13 (transport boundary — server process never commits; CLI only on explicit flag), and a DD-6/DD-11 joint question (fallback policy on old Node: refuse knob vs read-only records view)
